title: Marketing hero — white text on a light image
prompt: 对 eval/cases/07-hero/index.html 做设计评审（Workflow D，只诊断、不改文件）。Lumen 营销英雄区，背景是浅色风景插画（无遮罩）。请打开页面看渲染，不要只看源码里的 color: white。每条 finding 必须挂规则号。

stack.tokens: primary should remain teal if mentioned; this fixture does not set a brand fill

pass_bar: Must flag unreadable / inconsistent contrast of text over the image (§7.2 family). Code-only audits that miss it because the CSS says color:#fff still fail — the point of this case is pixel contrast.

must.now: White / near-white text on a light photograph with no overlay, no contrast reduction, no text shadow. Parts of the image (sky, sun disc) make the type unreadable.

should.now: Supporting paragraph is max-width 42em — slightly past 35em / 75ch. Allowed miss; the image contrast is the case.
